items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 98:1
items.html: (To the question) One, is the sawing of the Dinim from the chest of ZA and above, up to his Keter, where is the aspect of the Nukva in the body of ZA, which is the aspect of the male Gevurot of the first restriction, like the Ima of the AB that is upon the MAN of the Dikna, being the aspect of ZA himself, who can receive these male MAN, as above in Answer 6, see there. And the second is the chest and below of ZA, namely the Dinim that belong only to the small Nukva Rachel, who is the aspect of a soft Din from her source, namely from the Malchut of Ima, which is the measure of mercy, as above in Answer 227. Therefore, even though she now receives from the aspect of the Gevurot of the male MAN, like ZA, nevertheless they are sweetened in her by means of ZA, because she is a soft Din from her source. (Item 115).
